name: Torahiko
source:
Torahiko would later appear in the VN After Class developed by AndyPeng as a minor character when the main cast take a mini vacation to Waterfront Village and stay at his family's inn. In this VN, he is older and more muscular in appearance, and wears the same outfit he did in Morenatsu. 

[From [url=https://morenatsu.fandom.com/wiki/Torahiko_Ooshima]morenatsu.fandom.com[/url]]
